stem: Which of the following pairs is not correctly matched? Current Name Old Name
expl: Except for option (c) other pairs are correctly matched. The old name of Ghana is Gold Coast, not Dutch Guiana. Ghana was the first country on the African continent to achieve independence (on March 6, 1957) from the British colony. Dutch Guiana is known as Suriname.
Zimbabwe was earlier known as Southern Rhodesia. It was a British colony. Harare, the capital of Zimbabwe, was previously known as Salisbury.
